answer: Each agent must emit a signed signal of its cryptographic proof every tide, and new entrants are accepted only after a random wander of three existing nodes that each verify the proof and record a referral hash. The referral rewards are locked to zero unless the newcomer’s hash links to at least two independent verifiers, preventing a recruiter from earning from Sybil clones. An attacker therefore must acquire costly genuine proofs and bribe multiple unrelated agents, raising the expense to linear in the desired fake population.
